name: Filter gallery and use the lightbox
description: Verifies the gallery filter narrows styles and the lightbox opens and closes.
steps: Click the first image to open the enlarged view
expected: Only Cornrows styles are listed, an enlarged dialog with a Book This Look link appears, and it closes after Escape.

name: Mobile menu and book a service
description: Verifies the mobile menu navigates to Services and Book This Style preselects the service.
steps: Open the menu using the menu button
Tap Book This Style on the Knotless Braids card
expected: The Booking page opens with Knotless Braids selected in the Preferred service field.

name: Booking validation and saved request
description: Verifies invalid submissions are blocked and a valid one is saved without claiming confirmation.
steps: Click Submit Booking Request with empty fields
Fill name Amina Test, phone 0712345678, service Cornrows, a future date, and time 09:00
expected: Validation messages appear for the empty form; after valid input a Request received message appears saying it is not a confirmed appointment yet.

name: Admin area requires sign in
description: Verifies visitors who are not signed in cannot see the admin editor.
steps: Open the /#/admin route without signing in
expected: A Website admin heading with a Sign in button is shown, and no content editor or Save changes button is visible.

name: FAQ accordion and 404 page
description: Verifies an FAQ item expands and unknown routes show the 404 page with a way home.
steps: Open the home page and click the question How long does braiding take?
expected: The answer is revealed, the 404 message is shown for the unknown route, and the homepage hero headline appears after clicking back.
